title: A staff re-seed never overwrites a Space its owner has claimed (LIVE-1208)
detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-21. PREMISE RE-TESTED: on an update target materializeBusiness deleted and re-inserted availability and FAQs and rewrote profileData, and edit-wins covered only name, tagline, brand name and accent, with no check of claimed_at. It now asks isSpaceClaimed (lib/spaces/claim.ts, fail-closed) before any write and returns a plain refusal for a claimed Space.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const m=fs.readFileSync('lib/importer/materialize.ts','utf8');const c=fs.readFileSync('lib/spaces/claim.ts','utf8');const bad=[];if(!/isSpaceClaimed\(existing\.id\)/.test(m))bad.push('re-apply does not check the claim');if(!/export async function isSpaceClaimed/.test(c))bad.push('isSpaceClaimed is gone');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1208: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when a re-apply can run against a claimed Space.
